description: Deterministic compiler-backed relationship and impact corpus with negative controls.

files.src/target.ts: export function target(value: number): number { return value + 1; }
files.src/other.ts: export function target(value: number): number { return value - 1; }
files.src/adapter.ts:
import { leaf } from "./leaf.js";
export function adapter(): number { return leaf(); }
files.test/target.test.ts:
import { target } from "../src/target.js";
export const targetResult = target(1);
files.test/leaf.test.ts:
import { adapter } from "../src/adapter.js";
export const leafResult = adapter();

scenarios.description: A direct test reference is returned with exact compiler evidence.
An unrelated declaration with the same name does not become impact evidence.
A string-keyed handler table does not create a guessed relationship to the exact target.
Stale relationship metadata cannot produce an exact candidate list.
A depth-limited traversal cannot present the transitive test as complete evidence.
